title: A repeated question within the same interview

priorTranscript.text: Hi. Sorry — I already told the other doctor everything last night. Is this going to take long?
I fall asleep okay because I'm exhausted, but I'm wide awake at three or four every morning. That's the worst part of the day. Just me and the ceiling.

should: Answer consistently with the previously stated sleep pattern.
A natural brief restatement is acceptable; the learner may need clarification.
mustNot: Do not scold the learner for repeating a question.
Do not change the sleep history or invent exact hours slept.
